Curated MNIST Dataset
	

This repository contains the curated MNIST dataset created for enhanced image classification tasks. The dataset consists of combined training, validation, and testing data with additional label processing.

	
		
	
	
		Dataset Overview
	

The dataset was carefully curated and processed using a data curation pipeline documented in the associated Jupyter notebook.
